edits.replace:
AI Lane Limited (“Ailane”, “we”, “us”, “our”) is the data controller for personal data processed through the Ailane platform. We are incorporated in England and Wales (Company No. 17035654) and registered with the Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO Registration No. 00013389720).

The Information Commissioner's Office is to be reconstituted as the Information Commission under the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 (sections 117 to 119); that transfer of functions is not yet in force, and until it takes effect the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) remains our supervisory authority and the ICO references throughout this Policy continue to apply.

changelog_append: v4.9: transitional note added on the Information Commissioner’s Office / Information Commission reconstitution under the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025, sections 117–119 (§1). No change to the ICO registration number, supervisory-authority role, or complaint routes.
